reasoning: Entry boundary lies between k100=0.1 (all three tau_K enter at 16-20 s and stay in the refractory-limited plateau; the plateau is absorbing: Z=0, both inhibitory pathways gone, K 30-60x too weak) and k100>=0.25 (no entry by 34-40 s, Z stable 0.92-0.95).

The two extended conditions are the boundary-adjacent row: k100=0.25 with the fastest K (tau_K=1 s, gain 0.25) and k100=0.25 with tau_K=2.5 s (gain 0.1, i.e. the same per-spike increment as the old entering condition k100=0.1/tau_K=1 s), giving a same-increment/different-tau contrast.

Stopped conditions are censored, not failures: the two k100=0.1 plateaus add nothing beyond the old tau_K=1 s run and the causal branches; k100=0.25/tau5 and k100=0.5 rows are no-entry within their windows and are recorded as censored no-entry.
Independent noise seeds 9108402/9108403 are added to both extended conditions, plus one seed for the entering condition k100=0.1/tau_K=2.5 s to check that entry itself is noise-robust.
